{{Top|leg}}
The '''Guardian Elders''' were a subgroup of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]] organization known as the [[Guardians of the Breath]]. The Elders interpreted [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] received through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in order to advise the [[Kashi Mer]] civilization on the general course of action it should take.<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
